subject.title: fix(memory-wiki): propagate deadline signal and skip exhaustive fallback for supplement search

question: Should memory-wiki corpus supplements be digest-only and allowed to return fewer or zero results to guarantee the memory_search deadline, while explicit wiki_search remains exhaustive?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes the retrieval completeness established by the original supplement bridge; code and CI can verify mechanics but cannot decide whether that user-visible recall tradeoff is the intended product contract.

options.title: Adopt bounded supplements
options.body: Approve digest-only partial supplement results, document the contract, and require focused regression and large-vault proof before merge.

options.title: Preserve supplement completeness
options.body: Require indexed, cached, or more deeply abort-aware fallback so supplement searches retain exhaustive recall within the deadline.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded supplements
recommendation.body: Approve digest-only partial supplement results, document the contract, and require focused regression and large-vault proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored both the supplement bridge and digest fallback behavior whose contract is changing.
